capture.description: FT2232H programming an OpenVizsla FPGA and starting capture. The recorded device identity is VID 0x1d50, PID 0x607c, bcdDevice 0x0700.
capture.selection: Successful nonempty endpoint 0x81 bulk-IN completion records; USBPcap info byte 1, transfer type 3, status 0. Endpoint descriptor supplies 512-byte maximum packet size.
capture.scope: The capture includes FPGA programming and FIFO operation. The selected endpoint 0x81 stream follows channel A synchronous-FIFO mode selection. It establishes actual FTDI status-prefixed USB payloads, not UART-mode operation, one-megabaud line behavior, no-loss timing or physical A733 DMA.

format_reference.use: Reference for packed USBPcap field offsets, transfer type 3 and info-bit completion direction. No source code is imported or compiled.

check.behavior: The independent Python decoder removes two status bytes from each captured USB packet. The C replay submits the original captured completion payloads to the serial receive API and writes bytes from the returned application views. The check compares all output bytes and their fixed SHA-256.
check.limits: All selected recorded completions contain at most one 512-byte USB packet. Multiple packets within one transfer are covered by the separate constructed lifetime check, not by this recording.
